prayerExcerpt.en-US: Men of Galilee, why gaze in wonder at the heavens?
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Homens da Galileia, por que ficais aqui, parados, olhando para o céu?

meta.face: Christ as in recurring-figures.md: a man of about thirty-three with a LONG OVAL face narrowing gently to the chin — a high, smooth forehead, a long straight nose with a fine bridge, calm almond-shaped dark-brown eyes under level brown brows, high, softly modelled cheekbones, a quiet closed mouth; chestnut-brown hair parted in the centre and falling in soft waves past the shoulders; a short, full chestnut beard and moustache, lightly parted at the chin; in glory, a plain gold halo ringed with rays, a serene, loving look down on his disciples. Our Lady as in recurring-figures.md: the same face matured, a woman of about fifty with a delicate, softly OVAL face — a smooth high forehead, a fine straight nose with a narrow bridge, almond-shaped brown eyes under gently arched light-brown brows, softly rounded cheeks, a small rosy mouth, a small rounded chin; light-brown hair parted in the centre under a white inner veil and a blue mantle drawn over the head. Peter as on the peter card: about sixty-five, a broad, weathered fisherman's face, a strong wide nose, deep-set earnest eyes, a lined forehead; curly grey-white hair balding from the back with a curly tuft at the forehead; a short, square, curly grey-white beard. John as on the john_evangelist card: a beardless young man of about twenty-two with a smooth OVAL face, large upturned brown eyes, a straight nose, a small full mouth; wavy golden-brown hair to the jaw. The other Apostles behind, small and different: a dark-bearded man of forty with a long face (James), a grey-bearded older man with a broad face (Andrew), a young man with short black hair and a narrow, beardless face (Thomas). The angels: youthful, fair, oval-faced.
meta.basis: Acts 1:9-11, the entrance antiphon's 'Men of Galilee', and the traditional Ascension with Our Lady among the Apostles (Giotto, Scrovegni Chapel). Christ keeps the line from `transfiguration`; Peter and John keep the `peter` and `john_evangelist` faces; Our Lady matured.
